question: Perform NMF (init='nndsvda') for k=2 to 10 and compute consensus matrices using 50 runs per k. Derive 50 per-run integer seeds from np.random.RandomState(42) and use the i-th seed for both NMF and KMeans in run i. For each run, assign cluster labels via KMeans (n_init=1) on the W matrix. Build the consensus matrix as the fraction of runs in which each pair of samples is assigned to the same cluster. Select the optimal k as the one with the highest cophenetic correlation of its consensus matrix.
